inputs.name: CodexGatewayService.constructor.config
inputs.description: The gateway configuration object whose `token` is the shared bearer secret: fetch accepts a request only when its `authorization` header is exactly `Bearer ${token}` (checked by length, then timingSafeEqual), and it reads `token` on every call, so changing `token` after construction changes what fetch accepts. The constructor does not check the token; the `codex serve` command passes only a trimmed token of at least 32 characters, read from an owner-only token file.

inputs.name: CodexGatewayService.fetch.request
inputs.description: The incoming Fetch API Request: fetch reads its `origin` and `authorization` headers and its URL pathname and method, and for POST /v1/responses also its body and `thread-id` header, and an abort of its `signal` while a streamed response is open cancels the session. A body over 33,554,432 bytes, or a missing `thread-id` or one longer than 256 characters, produces a 400 invalid_request response rather than a thrown error.

outputs.name: CodexGatewayService.fetch
outputs.description: The Response the promise resolves to: a successful POST /v1/responses gets a 200 text/event-stream (a cached replay or a live stream), /healthz gets a 200 JSON health report, and every other case is a JSON error: 403 for a non-empty Origin header, 401 for a missing or mismatched bearer token, 404 for anything except /healthz and POST /v1/responses, 409 while the session has an active response, or 400 for any other failure in POST /v1/responses (error.code is invalid_request, or unsupported_content for a GatewayContentError). The promise does not reject for a Request object, because every error thrown while handling POST /v1/responses is caught and returned as a 400 response.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error that the private `respond` method throws for three conditions: a body over 33,554,432 bytes (message 'Request too large'), a missing or empty `thread-id` header or one longer than 256 characters (message 'thread-id required'), and an uncached request on a session that already holds 16 or more replays (message 'Prototype request limit reached'). `respond`'s own catch block turns each of these into a 400 invalid_request response, so fetch never rejects with it.

outputs.name: CodexGatewayService.constructor
outputs.description: The new CodexGatewayService instance that `new` returns, which keeps the config object by reference and an empty CodexSessionRepository in its private `repository` field. The constructor does no validation and cannot throw, because the only work CodexSessionRepository does on construction is creating an empty Map.
